scope: independent root audit of the general connection equations, unique integral horizontal solution for arbitrary q, integrability, divided-Frobenius compatibility, universal coefficient support, scope, capacity, and zero booking

checks.canonical_format_repair: restored the missing TeX backslash before qquad in the module display and replaced the malformed pq,d product by pq\,d

mathematical_audit.matrix_equations: For A=[[p,0],[pq,1]] and Gamma=[[a,b],[c,d]], dA+Gamma A=A F^*Gamma gives exactly the four displayed entry equations.
mathematical_audit.forced_entries: Because F^* sends one-forms into p times one-forms and the base is p-adically separated, b=pF^*b forces b=0; then a=F^*a and d=F^*d force a=d=0.
mathematical_audit.resolvent: The remaining equation is C(c)-c=dq with C=F^*/p. On W(k)[[H,S]] with standard Frobenius, C strictly raises adic order, so c=-sum_(j>=0) C^j(dq) is the unique integral solution for every analytic q.
mathematical_audit.integrability: Each C^j(dq)=p^{-j}d(F^j(q)) is closed, and the E21 matrix unit squares to zero. Hence the connection is flat and agrees with divided-Frobenius horizontality.
mathematical_audit.Griffiths_scope: For the two-step filtration, ordinary Griffiths transversality maps Fil^1 into Fil^0 and imposes no extra matrix zero. Filtration preservation would be a strictly stronger, unrequested axiom.
mathematical_audit.neutrality: Every q is allowed, so fixed rank, Hodge polygon, flatness, Griffiths transversality, and local Frobenius horizontality do not constrain the actual Q0 zero set.
mathematical_audit.coefficient_support: For q=sum y_i, the cotangent term is -sum dy_i. All labeled coefficient directions appear, but this is not a geometric conductor lower bound after pullback; dependencies and cancellations on the actual base remain open.
mathematical_audit.capacity: No prime-independent geometric family or weighted splitting-prime theorem follows. The fixed-j1 ceiling 1/36 and booking zero remain unchanged.
